Definition: species binomial exactly as printed in Table 1
Note: printed name preserved; taxonomy applied later via ../_keys/

Definition: common name as printed in Table 1
age of the specimen as printed; free text where an exact age was unknown (Adult, Young adult, >1)
Note: not numeric for every row - parse before use

Definition: sex of the specimen as printed
cerebral hemisphere the V1 sample was taken from (Left / Right)
fixation method: Perfusion = vascular perfusion with 4% paraformaldehyde; Immersion = immersion fixation in 10% formalin

Source Note: printed Table 1 column Fixation and its Note; Materials and Methods sec. 2.1, p. 2

Definition: brain mass of the specimen in grams, recorded at extraction
Note: printed footnote a: two values were recorded for one hemisphere and doubled (Giraffa camelopardalis, Neofelis nebulosa); footnote b: Homo sapiens uses the published adult-male average (Hartmann et al. 1994), not this specimen
Source Note: printed Table 1 column Brain mass (g) with footnotes a and b, p. 3

Definition: density of neurons in primary visual cortex (area V1), neurons per square millimetre of section area
Note: 2D areal density from single sections, NOT a volumetric density - not comparable with per-mg or per-mm3 neuron densities without conversion. Neurons identified by nucleolus, cellular shadow, relative size and lack of chromatin globules; counted on the centre of the nucleus from every 4th grid square, full cortical depth pia to white matter
Source Note: printed Table 1 column Neuron density (mm2); counting rules in Materials and Methods sec. 2.4 (Quantification), p. 5

Definition: density of mitochondria in area V1, mitochondria per square millimetre of section area
Note: 2D areal density; counted on high-magnification SEM tile scans from every 12th grid square. Sample mean 1,311,587 per mm2 (SD 200,731); invariant with brain mass in this sample
Source Note: printed Table 1 column Mitochondria density (mm2); method sec. 2.4, p. 5; sample mean in Results, p. 9

Definition: density of synapses in area V1, synapses per square millimetre of section area
Note: total synapses, NOT split into symmetric vs asymmetric types (tissue quality varied too much across sources). Synapses identified by electron-dense cleft, presynaptic vesicles, pre- or postsynaptic densities. Sample mean 706,865 per mm2 (SD 106,263)
Source Note: printed Table 1 column Synapse density (mm2); method sec. 2.4, p. 5; sample mean in Results, p. 8

Definition: length of the postsynaptic density (PSD) in nanometres, measured in area V1. The PSD is the protein network clustered around neurotransmitter receptors at the postsynaptic membrane
Note: measured only where the synaptic cleft was clearly visible (en-face or oblique cuts excluded); ImageJ line tool; mean 105.36 PSDs per brain (minimum 50). Remarkably uniform across species
Source Note: printed Table 1 column PSD length (nm); definition of PSD in Introduction p. 2; measurement rules in Materials and Methods sec. 2.4, p. 5

Definition: printed footnote marker (a, b) pointing to the brain-mass caveats
Note: a = hemisphere mass doubled; b = published average substituted
